title: Gem Mining Localities of the World
subtitle: Diamond, corundum, emerald and other gem mines with status and coordinates
description:
57 gem mining localities across 31 countries, from the mine map in Chapter 05 of the Erebaur encyclopedia: diamond, corundum (ruby and sapphire), emerald and other gem deposits, with coordinates, the stones produced, operating status as of September 2026 and a coordinate-quality grade.

Data: Erebaur (https://erebaur.com), CC BY 4.0. https://erebaur.com/atlas/

The data dictionary, sources and known limitations are in README.md.

resources.description: 57 gem mining localities across 31 countries, from the mine map in Chapter 05 of the Erebaur encyclopedia: diamond, corundum (ruby and sapphire), emerald and other gem deposits, with coordinates, the stones produced, operating status as of September 2026 and a coordinate-quality grade.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Locality name as used on the map.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84). A mine or nearest-town position; see coordinate_quality.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Map layer: diamond, corundum, emerald or other.

fields.name: stones
fields.description: Stones the locality produces or produced.

fields.name: status
fields.description: active, artisanal, closed or historic, as of September 2026.

fields.name: description
fields.description: One-line description written for the encyclopedia.

fields.name: coordinate_quality
fields.description: operator_stated: the operator’s own coordinate. published_coordinate: printed in a journal. approximate: a mine or town position, typically good to 0.1 to 0.3 degrees. weak: named in the editorial review as one of the least certain points.

fields.name: coordinate_precision_deg
fields.description: Estimated precision in degrees, where the editorial review states one. Empty otherwise.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: What Erebaur’s editorial review records about this locality’s coordinate, status or description. Empty when it records nothing.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Sources in Chapter 05’s list that are about this locality, separated by " | ". Otherwise the URL of the chapter’s full source list.

fields.name: erebaur_url
fields.description: The locality selected on the erebaur.com atlas map.
